title: Gravity's Rainbow
author: Thomas Pynchon
summary: Late in the Second World War, American soldier Tyrone Slothrop appears to be connected to the German V-2 rocket, and he is tracked across Europe by many parties. The sprawling, allusive novel has hundreds of characters.
readIf: you like enormous, difficult postmodern novels and are happy to be lost for long stretches.
skipIf: you want a clear storyline or are put off by dense, bizarre and sometimes disturbing material.
